item.title: SpaceX rocket crash on Moon leaves 60-foot crater
item.description: A discarded SpaceX Falcon 9 stage crashed into the Moon on Aug. 5, creating a crater about 60 feet wide, as revealed by NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter.

item.title: Schizophrenia linked to widespread synapse loss in brain
item.description: Brain scans show schizophrenia is associated with extensive loss of synapses, particularly on the left side of the brain, according to a new study.

item.title: Researchers propose major revision to human family tree
item.description: A new study suggests that Australopithecus and Paranthropus should be reclassified under the genus Homo, potentially reshaping our understanding of human evolution.

item.title: Why this total solar eclipse appeared golden
item.description: Spain's total solar eclipse showed a golden corona instead of the usual white, likely due to the Sun's low angle at sunset, which scattered light differently.
